description: Equipped with a 10000mAh battery capacity and 37Wh energy rating, this portable power bank provides dependable backup charging for compatible smartphones, wireless earbuds and other USB-powered accessories. Its rated capacity is 6700mAh. Enjoy efficient charging with up to 22.5W fast charging support through the USB-A output. The built-in Type-C cable supports up to 18W output, helping compatible devices recharge faster during travel, work or everyday use. The integrated Type-C and 8-Pin charging cables reduce the need to carry separate cables. Conveniently charge compatible Android and iOS devices directly from the power bank for a neat and practical charging experience. Charge up to three compatible devices using the built-in Type-C cable, built-in 8-Pin cable and USB-A output. Ideal for smartphones, earbuds and smart accessories. Charging speed may vary when multiple devices are connected simultaneously. Measuring 71.60 × 19.66 × 116.82mm and weighing only 204.4g, this compact power bank fits conveniently inside handbags, backpacks and travel pouches. Its slim, pocket-friendly design makes it easy to carry throughout the day. Designed with multiple-layer protection for reliable everyday charging. The power bank is BIS registered, RoHS compliant and made in India, offering a dependable portable charging solution for regular personal and travel use. A 30cm USB-A to Type-C cable is included for convenient recharging of the power bank. The Type-C input supports 5V/3A, 9V/2A and 12V/1.5A input profiles, providing up to 18W power bank recharging support.
